newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate down after rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate down after rate cut.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight interbank rate was softer at midday on Monday, reflecting the central bank's cut of banks' reserve requirements on Friday, brokers said.
The rate was at 5.620 percent, compared with 5.651 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.60-5.65 against 5.50.
The central banks said its rate cut would pump T$25 billion into the market and dealers expected the interbank rate to move toward 5.50 percent in the near term.
The seven-year 83/2 bond yield was at 5.520, the 10-year 84/1 was at 5.6925-7000 and the seven-year 85/3 was at 5.6200. Traders expected a consolidation phase. - Julie Hu (2-5080815)
